comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling finished homes to consumers with mortgage and title arms, not a developer selling finished lots to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder selling homes to consumers plus mortgage and rental operations; lot development is secondary, though it is Forestar's parent.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Asset-light homebuilder selling homes to consumers; it buys lots rather than developing and selling them.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops land into finished lots and sells some to third-party builders, though it is mainly a homebuilder.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds and sells homes to consumers with mortgage and title services; it is not a lot developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Homebuilder using option-purchased lots, with mortgage banking; it sells homes to consumers, not lots to builders.
